text: Anika's dad is back in hospital, chest infection again. She's covering the Morris account from home this week. Text her Thursday to see how he's doing.
ryan off sick since monday, back hopefully after the weekend. his boss keeps emailing him anyway, he's fuming
Eilidh got the team lead role!! starts 3rd of June. must send congrats before she hears it from anyone else

Call with Kiara. Her son Theo broke his wrist at football on Saturday, cast for six weeks. She's knackered, been up most nights because he can't get comfy. Her mum's coming down to help next week. Also she said the Walsh pitch got pushed to sometime after half term, which is a relief for everyone, and she's finally booked her own holiday for 14 to 21 May.

So I was chatting to Ignacio after the client call and he mentioned his partner Ines is expecting, due sometime in the spring. They haven't picked names yet. He also said he's thinking about going part time after the baby comes but hasn't raised it with his manager.
Björn - coeliac, don't book the pasta place for the team lunch
Rohan's knee op is May 14. Ask him the week after how recovery's going.
reggie retiring end of march!! leaving do tbc. chip in for the card
Dentist 14/05 9.20. Car MOT sometime next month, book it.

Siddharth said Mr Walsh from the client side is a nightmare to deal with, keeps moving deadlines. Sid's stressed, didn't sleep last week. Their director Rafael promised to step in but hasn't. Sid's thinking about asking to move teams in the new year. I should take him for a proper lunch next week and let him vent, he really looks like he needs it.
zhang's mum diagnosed with diabetes, she's sorting meal plans for her. zhang lives with her parents in leeds
Yusuf Osei, Yus to everyone at work, wants to move into data. Doing an evening course from September.
Note to self: Mai's interview at the bank is June 3rd. She's really nervous about the panel bit. Text her good luck the night before.
Freya and her husband have their tenth anniversary on 22 August, going to Lisbon for it
darius had covid, still wiped out two weeks later, says brain fog is the worst bit. check in on him friday
Ines loves bouldering, goes three times a week. Hates mornings.
Fatima's conference talk in Berlin got cancelled, they pulled the whole track. She's gutted, had the slides done.

Okay so quick recap of lunch with Kavya. Her daughter has been in and out of the GP with ear infections, they're finally seeing a specialist on 9 July. Kavya's taken a few days off around it. Work's been rubbish too, her manager Idris is leaving after Christmas and nobody knows who's replacing him. She asked if I could keep an eye on her inbox while she's off. Need to ask her on the 10th how the appointment went.
Idris is off to Singapore with his family over Easter. His wife's from there.
Marisol mentioned she'd love a decent pair of running headphones, hers keep falling out. Bday in November.
Omar's dog Biscuit had surgery on his hip yesterday. Omar sounded wrecked. Drop round with something on the weekend.
Arjun and Rebecca moving in together, flat viewings sometime after Christmas. They're thinking Bristol.
Rebecca's sister Niamh has her driving test on 5/14, third attempt, she's a wreck about it apparently

Jun mentioned his manager gave him a bad review, he's really down. Meeting HR on Tuesday. Must message him after. He said the feedback came out of nowhere, nobody flagged anything at his mid year in July. His girlfriend Mai thinks he should start looking elsewhere, and honestly I agree.
Lena's started physio for her back, twice a week until mid November. Can't lift anything so I'm doing the shop for her.
Dimitri is the new account manager for the Novak contract. From Athens originally, very into sailing.
hemi said his little girl starts nursery in jan, he's dreading drop off more than she is
Juan's flight home to Bogotá is on 12th December. His grandad isn't doing well. Don't forget to message him before he goes.
Rafael - vegetarian, allergic to nuts, doesn't drink. Remember for the offsite.
pick up prescription, return parcel, ring the council about the bins
Anika's leaving drinks were meant to be on Friday but they've been called off, she's staying on another month instead.
Ryan Kim from procurement, his wife had a baby girl on 2nd of October! Ava. Send something from the team.
Eilidh's mum has a hip replacement in the new year, date not confirmed. Eilidh's taking leave to look after her.

So Kiara's been feeling really overwhelmed at work lately, I think the restructure is getting to her. Her review's on June 10th and she's convinced it'll go badly. I told her I'd look over her notes. Should probably ring her the day before to go through it, and then again after to see how it went. Her partner Rohan is apparently being great about it though.
Ignacio's birthday 18 Feb. Into vinyl, specifically old salsa records.
Talked to Björn about the Q3 numbers. He's presenting to the board on September 4th, first time. He seemed pretty calm about it actually.
theo's appendix out last night, he's fine, home tomorrow. his mum's staying with him
Got the date wrong before, Siddharth's wedding is 3/8 not 8/3. So March 8th. Hen and stag both in Feb sometime
Reggie's back at work after the stroke, part time for now. Doing really well considering.
Zhang mentioned she's applying for the senior designer role, interviews soon, probably late spring.
Yusuf's daughter is poorly with tonsillitis again, he's working from home. Third time this term. I should send him the number of that ENT Lena saw.
Mai and her boyfriend Darius just got back from Japan. She loved Kyoto, he got food poisoning on day two lol
freya's cat Pickle went missing tuesday night. she's put posters everywhere. text her tomorrow, see if he's turned up

Morning. Ines rang, her brother Arjun was in a car accident on the M6 at the weekend. Broken ribs, concussion, kept in for observation. He's ok but shaken. She's driving up to see him Friday and will be off work until at least the 21st. Covering her client calls Monday and Tuesday. Need to send her the call notes after each one.
Fatima starts at Deloitte on 1 November. Big step up for her.

Need to book flights for the Madrid trip sometime this month, prices going up. Also renew passport. Mum's 70th is 6 June so the trip has to be before that, ideally the end of April. Ask work about leave before the rota goes out.
Kavya's son Omar got into Edinburgh for medicine!! Starts September.
Idris says his dad's dementia is getting worse, they're looking at care homes in the new year. He's struggling.
Marisol Usman, client contact at Williams & Co. Prefers calls to email. Kids: two boys.
Arjun's 30th is on the 27th, party at his place. Rebecca hinted he wants a proper espresso machine. Remind me to sort a group present by the 20th.
Rebecca's off on maternity from 15 March, due early April. Handover meetings with Niamh before then.
Jun and his wife celebrated their anniversary last weekend, he took her to that Korean place. ask how it was
Lena said Dimitri might be made redundant, consultation meeting Thursday. He hasn't heard anything official yet. Keep an eye on him.

Called Hemi. His son's been in hospital since Sunday with a nasty bout of pneumonia, on IV antibiotics. Hemi's practically living there. His wife Marisol is doing nights. I'm dropping dinners round Wednesday. Ask at work if anyone else wants to help.

Juan's going to the Lake District sometime in May with his walking group. He's been training for weeks. Last time he did it he twisted his ankle on the first day and had to be driven back, so he's paranoid. His wife Kiara isn't going, she's got a work thing on May 9th and their dog Rolo can't be left. Ask him when he's back how it went.
Rafael is head of compliance now. Still plays bass in a covers band on weekends.
Gym 6.30 tomorrow, then work. Haircut Saturday.
Anika mentioned Ryan's off again, migraines this time. She thinks it's stress from the Nguyen project. We're both going to keep an eye on him.
Dr Kim said results in about two weeks. Chase on 4 Nov if nothing.

Quick one, Eilidh's flatmate Reggie (her ex's cousin, long story) is doing the Edinburgh half on May 25th, first ever race, he's terrified. Text him good luck that morning, and ask Eilidh after how he got on. Also she said sometime in June she wants us all to do a weekend away.
